svg.title: Timeline analysis: many artifacts, one normalized sequence
svg.desc: File-system MACB timestamps, event logs, the registry, browser history, and prefetch are parsed by The Sleuth Kit or plaso into one super-timeline in UTC. Read outward from the initial-access moment, such as an attachment opened, to credential theft, lateral movement, staging, and exfiltration. Pitfalls: timestomping, clock drift, and mixed time zones.
svg.text: Timeline analysis: many artifacts, one normalized sequence

g.text: timestomping, clock drift, mixed time zones
